patterns: Can I return a product within 30 days?
responses: We offer a hassle-free 30-day return policy for unused items in original packaging with receipt.

patterns: What are your store opening hours?
responses: Our flagship stores are open Monday to Saturday from 9:00 AM to 9:00 PM, and Sunday from 10:00 AM to 6:00 PM.
Online customer support is available 24/7.
We offer free standard shipping on all orders over $50! Orders under $50 have a flat $4.99 shipping fee.
Express next-day shipping is available for $12.99.

patterns: What payment options do you accept?
responses: We accept Visa, MasterCard, American Express, PayPal, Apple Pay, Google Pay, and store gift cards.
Cash on delivery is available for select postal codes.

patterns: Where can I find the size chart?
How do I choose the right size?
responses: Each product page has a 'Size Guide' link right next to the size selector with detailed measurement charts in inches and cm.

patterns: Are there any promo codes available?
responses: Sign up for our newsletter to get 15% off your first order! Students get 10% off via StudentBeans verification.

patterns: How do I talk to a human?
responses: You can call our toll-free line at 1-800-SMART-RETAIL (Mon-Fri 8am-8pm EST) or email support@smartretail.com.
Visit smartretail.com/stores to view our store locator map and find the closest branch to your address.
Orders can be canceled within 1 hour of placing them. Go to 'My Orders' -> 'Cancel Item'. After 1 hour, please use the return process upon delivery.

patterns: Can I exchange for a different size?
responses: Yes! Exchanges for size or color are completely free within 30 days of purchase.

patterns: How to check gift card balance?
responses: Digital e-gift cards from $10 to $500 can be purchased online. You can check your gift card balance during checkout.
Smart Rewards lets you earn 1 point per $1 spent. Every 100 points converts to a $5 discount reward on future purchases.

patterns: When will out of stock items restock?
Is this item available in store?
responses: Click 'Notify Me When Available' on any product page to receive an instant email when stock is replenished.

patterns: When will I get my refund?
How long does refund processing take?
responses: Once your return package reaches our warehouse, refunds are processed within 3-5 business days to your original payment method.
